CITY OF ALHAMBRA PLANNING COMMISSION
  ACTION MINUTES

  Regular Meeting
  June 3, 2024

A.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER:  7:02 P.M. in the Council Chambers of Alhambra City Hall, and
  via video conference and teleconference.

B.  ROLL CALL:

  Present:  Dorado, Gardea, Grijalva, Mojarro, Garcia, Olson

  Absent:  Ho, Juarez, Pham, Tsujii

  Staff Present: Vanessa Reynoso, Deputy Director; Maia McCurley, Principal Planner;
  Yalini Siva, Senior Planner; Megan Wu, Associate Planner; Avery Tao,
  Planning Technician; Erica Vega, Deputy City Attorney

C.  FLAG SALUTE:  Led by President Olson

D.  CONSENT AGENDA:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 1:  MINUTES – MAY 6, 2024 (7:03 P.M.)
  • Request: This is a request for the Planning Commission to approve
  the Minutes of the May 6, 2024, Regular Meeting of the Alhambra
  Planning Commission.
  • Recommended Action: Commission review and approve as
  submitted the Minutes of the May 6, 2024, Regular Meeting of the
  Alhambra Planning Commission.

  AGENDA
  ITEM 3:  GENERAL PLAN CONSISTENCY FOR THE TRANSFER OF PROPERTY
  FROM THE CITY TO THE WEST SAN GABRIEL VALLEY YMCA (7:03
  P.M.)
  • Request: Consideration of a Resolution determining the transfer of
  property from the City to the West San Gabriel Valley YMCA is
  consistent with the City’s General Plan pursuant to Government
  Code Section 65402.
  • Recommended Action: Adopt Resolution No. 24-12 determining
  that the proposed transfer of the western portion of the property is
  consistent with the City’s General Plan.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Consent Agenda Items 1 and 3.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Gardea, Seconded by Vice President Garcia.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  1
  06/03/2024
   Roll Call Vote: 6-0-0-4
  Ayes:  Dorado, Gardea, Grijalva, Mojarro, Garcia, Olson
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Ho, Juarez, Pham, Tsujii

AGENDA
ITEM 2:  EXTENSION FOR PLANNED DEVELOPMENT PERMIT PD-22-34 AND
  CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT CUP-22-15 (7:05 P.M.)
  • Request: This is a request for a one-year extension for the previously
  approved Planned Development Permit PD-22-34 and Conditional
  Use Permit CUP-22-15 to demolish an existing 40,908 square foot
  one-story office and warehouse building to allow for the construction
  of a four-story, 96,676 square foot self-storage building on an
  approximately 1.15 acres site located in the I (Industrial) zone.
  • Recommended Action: Adopt Resolution No. 24-10 approving a
  one-year extension to July 28, 2025, for the previously approved
  Planned Development Permit PD-22-34 and Conditional Use Permit
  CUP-22-15 subject to the Conditions of Approval, and finding the
  one-year extension for Planned Development Permit PD-22-34 and
  Conditional Use Permit CUP-22-15 to be exempt from review under
  the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to Section
  15332, Class 32 of Title 14 of the California Code of Regulations,
  which exempts from CEQA review projects characterized as in-fill
  development.
  • Public Comments:
  1.) Steven DeLateur

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Consent Agenda Item 2.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Dorado, Seconded by Vice President Garcia.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 5-1-0-4
  Ayes:  Dorado, Grijalva, Mojarro, Garcia, Olson
  Noes:  Gardea
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Ho, Juarez, Pham, Tsujii

•  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio and video
  recordings of the discussion is available here:
  Audio:
  PC Meeting - June 3, 2024 (Audio).m4a
  Video:

  2
  06/03/2024
 E.  DISCUSSION ITEMS:

  •  There were no Discussion Items.

F.  PUBLIC HEARINGS:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 4:  ZONING  MAP  AMENDMENT  AMD-23-05,  GENERAL  PLAN
  AMENDMENT AMD-23-06, PLANNED DEVELOPMENT PERMIT PD-23-
  43, PLANNED DEVELOPMENT PERMIT PD-23-44, PLANNED
  DEVELOPMENT PERMIT PD-23-45, CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT CUP-
  23-19, CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT CUP-23-20, AND TENTATIVE
  PARCEL MAP TPM-23-02 (7:19 P.M.)
  • 126, 132, and 146 South Palm Avenue; 127 South Raymond
  Avenue; 2018 Teagarden Lane
  • Applicant: Jennifer Lange of Land Development Consultants
  • Request: This is an application for a Zoning Map Amendment,
  General Plan Amendment, Planned Development Permits,
  Conditional Use Permits, and Tentative Parcel Map to allow the
  construction of a new commercial development with three quick-
  serve food-related uses (a Starbucks®, a Raising Cane’s®, and a
  Panda Express®) totaling 7,053 square feet of floor area located
  within a 2.7-acre site consisting of four parcels. The proposed project
  is requesting a General Plan Map Amendment to change the General
  Plan land use classification from Industrial to General Commercial,
  and a Zoning Map Amendment to change the Zoning classification
  from I (Industrial) to CMU (Commercial Mixed-Use) to facilitate the
  proposed development.
  • Recommended Action: Adopt Resolution No. 24-11 recommending
  that the City Council approve Zoning Map Amendment AMD-23-05,
  General Plan Amendment AMD-23-06, Planned Development Permit
  PD-23-43, Planned Development Permit PD-23-44, Planned
  Development Permit PD-23-45, Conditional Use Permit CUP-23-19,
  Conditional Use Permit CUP-23-20, Tentative Parcel Map TPM-23-
  02, Mitigated Negative Declaration, and Mitigation Monitoring and
  Reporting Program subject to the Conditions of Approval, and finding
  Zoning Map Amendment AMD-23-05, General Plan Amendment
  AMD-23-06, Planned Development Permit PD-23-43, Planned
  Development Permit PD-23-44, Planned Development Permit PD-
  23-45, Conditional Use Permit CUP-23-19, Conditional Use Permit
  CUP-23-20, and Tentative Parcel Map TPM-23-02 will not have any
  significant environmental impact based on the findings of an Initial
  Study and Mitigated Negative Declaration prepared pursuant to the
  California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA).
  • Principal Planner Maia McCurley provided the Staff presentation.
  • Hersel Zahab and Brandon Layman, members of the Applicant
  team, as well as Jana Robbins of Transtech Engineers, the City’s
  Traffic Engineer, were available to answer questions.
  • The public hearing was opened and then closed.
  • Public Comments:

  3
  06/03/2024
   1.) Lewis McCammon
  2.) Melissa Michelson
  3.) George Rhyner (KOA Consultants)

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Agenda Item 4 with the following added Conditions of
  Approval:
  1.) City Council shall consider the re-zoning of the adjacent properties
  at 117 South Raymond Avenue (APN 5342-022-058) and 128 South
  Palm Avenue (APN 5342-022-037) to CMU (Commercial Mixed-
  Use).
  2.) Consider  site  plan  revisions  to  include  pedestrian
  interconnectedness on-site and off-site.
  3.) Reconsider the design of the public right-of-way to include a parkway
  with trees.
  4.) Consider re-positioning the two (2) buildings [Panda Express and
  Raising Cane’s] for ease of vehicular egress and ingress.
  5.) Reconsider the plant palette to include larger native trees for the site,
  such as Sycamores or Tristania.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Gardea, Seconded by Commissioner Grijalva.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 5-1-0-4
  Ayes:  Gardea, Grijalva, Mojarro, Garcia, Olson
  Noes:  Dorado
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Ho, Juarez, Pham, Tsujii

G.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:

  •  Lewis McCammon inquired about the transfer of land from the West San Gabriel
  Valley YMCA to accommodate the City’s proposed new dog park. Mr. McCammon
  also discussed using some sales tax revenue to fund affordable housing elsewhere in
  the City, and inquired about requirements to provide minimum residential density on
  Housing Element Sites Inventory sites. (8:48 P.M.)

  •  There were no comments from Staff.

J.  ADJOURNMENT:

  •  There being no other business, the meeting was adjourned at 8:55 P.M. to Monday,
  July 1, 2024, at 7:00 P.M.
